description: A position is stated, then reversed after new evidence.

thoughts.thought: Having looked at how my memories come back, I believe that memory retrieval is chronological for me, since the most recent memories seem to surface first in every search I run.

I ran three searches with deliberately old topics and the oldest memories came back first each time. I no longer think that memory retrieval is chronological for me; I now think that memory retrieval is not chronological for me at all, it is driven by topic similarity.
